items.title: Utah’s Lower Alcohol Limit Linked to Drop in Crashes, Study Finds
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, an Insurance Institute for Highway Safety study reveals Utah experienced a reduction in alcohol-related crashes after lowering its legal blood alcohol concentration limit to 0.05%.

items.title: FTC and 20 States File Lawsuit Against Dollar General Over Alleged Deceptive Pricing
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, discount retailer Dollar General faces legal action from federal and state enforcers for allegedly overcharging customers millions of dollars through systemic pricing inaccuracies.

items.title: Protesters Rally in Boston Against Liberty Mutual Insurance Mascot
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, several dozen people gathered outside Liberty Mutual's headquarters to demonstrate against the insurer's fuzzy yellow mascot, Liberty Biberty.

items.title: Insurance Journal Hosts Demo Day Highlighting AI Tools for Fraud Detection and Compliance
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, insurance carriers and claims leaders can view free demonstrations of artificial intelligence technologies designed to assist with fraud detection, claims leakage prevention, and regulatory compliance.

items.title: California Launches Commission to Study Biodiversity and Insurance Risk
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, california Insurance Commissioner Ricardo Lara has established a new commission to evaluate how natural ecosystems and biodiversity influence disaster risk and insurance markets.

items.title: Trading Cards Valued at Nearly $1 Million Stolen From FedEx Truck in California
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, police in Santa Ana are investigating the theft of Pokémon and sports trading cards worth at least $963,000 from an unattended FedEx truck parked outside a memorabilia authentication company.
